
## Setup

```{r}
library(tidyverse)

# 1. File paths for all studies

study_paths <- tribble(
  ~study,    ~path,
  "Study 1", "/Users/sm6511/Desktop/Prediction-Accomodation-Exp/data/Combined/df_long_for_R-Study1.csv",
  "Study 2", "/Users/sm6511/Desktop/Prediction-Accomodation-Exp/data/Study2.0/Cleaned/df_long_for_R-Study2.csv",
  "Study 3", "/Users/sm6511/Desktop/Prediction-Accomodation-Exp/data/Combined/df_long_for_R-Study3.csv",
  "Study 4", "/Users/sm6511/Desktop/Prediction-Accomodation-Exp/data/Combined/df_long_for_R-Study4.csv",
  "Study 5", "/Users/sm6511/Desktop/Prediction-Accomodation-Exp/data/Combined/df_long_for_R-Study5.csv"
)


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Load and combine
# ------------------------------------------------------------

df_all <- study_paths |>
  mutate(
    data = map(
      path,
      ~ read_csv(.x, show_col_types = FALSE)
    )
  ) |>
  select(study, data) |>
  unnest(data) |>
  mutate(
    study = factor(
      study,
      levels = paste("Study", 1:5)
    ),

    # Standardize task labels (to all lowercase)
    task = str_to_lower(as.character(task)),
    task = case_when(
      task %in% c("predict", "predictor", "prediction") ~ "Predictor",
      task %in% c("accommodate", "accommodator", "accommodation") ~ "Accommodator",
      TRUE ~ task
    ),

    task = factor(
      task,
      levels = c("Accommodator", "Predictor")
    ),

    # Standardize relevance labels (same as above)
    feature_relevance = str_to_lower(
      as.character(feature_relevance)
    ),

    feature_relevance = case_when(
      feature_relevance == "relevant"   ~ "Relevant",
      feature_relevance == "irrelevant" ~ "Irrelevant",
      TRUE ~ feature_relevance
    ),

    feature_relevance = factor(
      feature_relevance,
      levels = c("Relevant", "Irrelevant")
    ),

    # Clean dimension labels for plotting
    feature_dimension = str_to_sentence(
      as.character(feature_dimension)
    )
  )


```

```{r}
# ------------------------------------------------------------:
# collapse across time (for study 5) and feature relevance
# ------------------------------------------------------------

participant_summary <- df_all |>
  group_by(
    study,
    participant,
    task,
    feature_dimension
  ) |>
  summarise(
    mean_importance = mean(
      feature_importance,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
```

```{r}
# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. Means by task/dimension
# ------------------------------------------------------------

task_summary <- participant_summary |>
  group_by(
    study,
    task,
    feature_dimension
  ) |>
  summarise(
    mean_importance = mean(
      mean_importance,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    n = n(),
    sd = sd(
      mean_importance,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    se = sd / sqrt(n),
    .groups = "drop"
  )


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 5. Find the difference (Accommodate - Predict)
# ------------------------------------------------------------


difference_summary <- task_summary |>
  select(
    study,
    feature_dimension,
    task,
    mean_importance,
    n,
    se
  ) |>
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = task,
    values_from = c(mean_importance, n, se)
  ) |>
  mutate(
    difference =
      mean_importance_Accommodator -
      mean_importance_Predictor,

    difference_se = sqrt(
      se_Predictor^2 +
      se_Accommodator^2
    ),

    lower = difference - difference_se,
    upper = difference + difference_se
  )

difference_summary
```

```{r}
# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Plot collapsed across relevance and time
# ------------------------------------------------------------

difference_plot <- ggplot(
  difference_summary,
  aes(
    x = study,
    y = difference,
    group = feature_dimension,
    shape = feature_dimension
  )
) +
  geom_hline(
    yintercept = 0,
    linewidth = 0.8,
    linetype = "dashed",
    color = "grey45"
  ) +
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(
      ymin = lower,
      ymax = upper
    ),
    width = 0.10,
    linewidth = 0.8,
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.45)
  ) +
  geom_point(
    size = 4,
    stroke = 1.1,
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.45)
  ) +
  scale_shape_discrete(
    name = "Feature dimension"
  ) +
  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = paste0(
      "Mean Importance Rating Difference"
    ),
    title = "Accommodate - Predict across studies") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 16) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(
      angle = 35,
      hjust = 1
    ),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold")
  )

difference_plot
```


```{r}
library(tidyverse)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Load correlation data from all studies
# ------------------------------------------------------------

study_paths <- tribble(
  ~study,    ~path,
  "Study 1", "/Users/sm6511/Desktop/Prediction-Accomodation-Exp/data/Combined/df_corr_for_R_Study1.csv",
  "Study 2", "/Users/sm6511/Desktop/Prediction-Accomodation-Exp/data/Combined/df_corr_for_R_Study2.csv",
  "Study 3", "/Users/sm6511/Desktop/Prediction-Accomodation-Exp/data/Combined/df_corr_for_R_Study3.csv",
  "Study 4", "/Users/sm6511/Desktop/Prediction-Accomodation-Exp/data/Combined/df_corr_for_R_Study4.csv",
  "Study 5", "/Users/sm6511/Desktop/Prediction-Accomodation-Exp/data/Combined/df_corr_for_R_Study5.csv"
)

df_corr_all <- study_paths |>
  mutate(
    data = map(
      path,
      ~ read_csv(.x, show_col_types = FALSE)
    )
  ) |>
  select(study, data) |>
  unnest(data) |>
  mutate(
    study = factor(
      study,
      levels = paste("Study", 1:5)
    ),

    # Standardize task labels
    task = str_to_lower(as.character(task)),
    task = case_when(
      task %in% c("predict", "predictor", "prediction") ~ "Predictor",
      task %in% c("accommodate", "accommodator", "accommodation") ~ "Accommodator",
      TRUE ~ task
    ),
    task = factor(
      task,
      levels = c("Accommodator", "Predictor")
    ),

    # Standardize dimension labels
    feature_dimension = str_to_sentence(
      as.character(feature_dimension)
    )
  ) |>
  filter(
    task %in% c("Predictor", "Accommodator"),
    !is.na(participant),
    !is.na(feature_dimension),
    !is.na(correlation)
  )


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Participant-level means
#
# Because feature_relevance and time are omitted from group_by(),
# this collapses across relevant versus irrelevant features
# ------------------------------------------------------------
participant_summary_corr <- df_corr_all |>
  group_by(
    study,
    participant,
    task,
    feature_dimension
  ) |>
  summarise(
    mean_correlation = mean(
      correlation,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  )


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Descriptive task means
# ------------------------------------------------------------

task_summary_corr <- participant_summary_corr |>
  group_by(
    study,
    task,
    feature_dimension
  ) |>
  summarise(
    mean_correlation = mean(
      mean_correlation,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    n = sum(!is.na(mean_correlation)),
    sd = sd(
      mean_correlation,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    se = sd / sqrt(n),
    .groups = "drop"
  )


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Predictor minus Accommodator
# ------------------------------------------------------------

difference_summary_corr <- task_summary_corr |>
  select(
    study,
    feature_dimension,
    task,
    mean_correlation,
    n,
    se
  ) |>
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = task,
    values_from = c(mean_correlation, n, se)
  ) |>
  mutate(
    difference =
      mean_correlation_Accommodator -
      mean_correlation_Predictor,

    difference_se = sqrt(
      se_Predictor^2 +
      se_Accommodator^2
    ),

    lower = difference - difference_se,
    upper = difference + difference_se
  )


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Plot Predictor - Accommodator correlation differences
# ------------------------------------------------------------

difference_plot_corr <- ggplot(
  difference_summary_corr,
  aes(
    x = study,
    y = difference,
    group = feature_dimension,
    shape = feature_dimension
  )
) +
  geom_hline(
    yintercept = 0,
    linewidth = 0.8,
    linetype = "dashed",
    color = "grey45"
  ) +
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(
      ymin = lower,
      ymax = upper
    ),
    width = 0.10,
    linewidth = 0.8,
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.45)
  ) +
  geom_point(
    size = 4,
    stroke = 1.1,
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.45)
  ) +
  scale_shape_discrete(
    name = "Feature dimension"
  ) +
  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = paste0(
      "Difference in mean correlation"
    ),
    title = "Accommodate - Predict correlation") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 16) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(
      angle = 35,
      hjust = 1
    ),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold")
  )

difference_plot_corr
```
